newsitem.title: USA: Northeast Utilities faces class-action suit.
newsitem.headline: Northeast Utilities faces class-action suit.

text.p: The law firms of Wolf Popper LLP and Schrader and Knapp said on Monday they filed a shareholder lawsuit against Northeast Utilities alleging securities-law violations.

The lawsuit seeking class-action status was filed in U.S. District Court in Connecticut, accusing Northeast and its chairman, Bernard Fox, of misrepresenting the state of its nuclear operations. The company's stock price declined steeply after problems were revealed, the law firms said.
The suit was filed on behalf of people who invested during the period from March 18, 1994 through April 5, 1996.
Northeast Utilities officials said they could not comment on the suit because they had not been served with it.
